name: Spicy North African Potato Salad
assumptions: Yield estimated from total ~1.2 kg ingredients (650 g potatoes + 550 g others) as typical 4 modest side-salad or light-lunch portions
Preparation time summed from explicit 20 min boil plus ~10 min for chopping, whisking, assembly and tossing
Feta listed as dairy cheese so Vegetarian=true but Vegan=false and Dairy-free=false
Pine nuts classified as tree nuts so Tree nuts=true
Harissa spice assumed wheat-free; no barley/rye/wheat detected so Gluten-free=true
No explicit egg, fish, shellfish, peanut, soy or sesame ingredients; Sesame left null because compound spice blends can occasionally contain it
Mint, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, pepper, spring onions, rocket and potatoes introduce no listed allergens
SourceDietLabels and tags treated only as hints; final flags derived strictly from enumerated ingredients
instructions:
Cook potatoes - place potatoes in a pot of cold water, and bring to the boil. Boil 20 minutes, or until potatoes are tender. You know they are cooked when you can stick a knife in them and the knife goes straight through.
Combine harissa spice, olive oil, salt and pepper and lemon juice in a small bowl and whisk until combined.
Once potatoes are cooked, drain water and roughly chop potatoes in half.
Add harissa mix and spring onions/green onions to potatoes and stir.
In a large salad bowl, lay out arugula/rocket.
Top with potato mix and toss.
Add fetta, mint and sprinkle over pine nuts.
Adjust salt and pepper to taste.
